summary.text: Claire Snyder-Hall represents District 14 in the Delaware House of Representatives, serving Rehoboth Beach, Dewey Beach and the southern part of Lewes; she was elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Before her election, she led the Delaware office of Common Cause for five years.
She was a tenured faculty member at George Mason University before moving to Rehoboth full-time in 2011.
She holds a PhD in political science and a BA from Smith College.
